original: The Progressive Conservatives brought an emergency two hour debate to the floor Wednesday to discuss the current shortage of family doctors and the decision by the new health authority to limit how many doctors can work at walk-in clinics or set up shop in the Halifax area.
sampled:
Opposition Leader Gary Burrill slammed Premier Stephen McNeil and his government for being "irresponsible," and for failing to provide any new funding for doctors and nurses during the election campaign.
"This is just some kind of political gimmick," Burrill said. "This is just one more example of this government not putting its trust in its people."
He said the NDP will not be attending the meeting because they believe the Conservatives are not trying to help Nova Scotians.
"It is just an excuse to put people on and to put people off. I don't think it is going to help the situation," Burrill said.
The Liberals, who are in power now, say the NDP will not be invited to attend Wednesday's meeting because they refuse to provide any money to help hire more family doctors and nurses.
"It is just an attempt by the NDP to make it look as if they are doing something they haven't done," said Liberal health critic Cathy Bennett.
